description: A scoped inline flag is refused at validation here; the baseline applies the flag and matches.
descriptor: { descriptor_version: "1.0", root: { type: "object", children: { a: { type: "string", pattern: "(?i:abc)" } } } }

divergence.note: docs/grammars.md §1.2 and §1.3 fix which layer reports each regex construct, and §1.2 states that the two implementations can name the same problem at different layers while the outcome (refused, named, never guessed at) does not differ. This is a documented, intentional divergence from the executed baseline under that rule (SPEC.md amendment 26), not a baseline defect.  This engine compiles the scoped inline flag, so the dialect scan refuses it at validation as an inline flag (docs §1.2 excludes inline flags, the scoped form included). The baseline applies the flag and reports no issue for a value that matches only case-insensitively.
